hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.go) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; root=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; grep -q 'GO_FMT_FILE' "$root/Makefile" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; GO_FMT_FILE="$f" make -s -C "$root" fmt >&2 || { echo "format hook: make fmt failed for $f" >&2; exit 2; }; }
